token.label: Personal Access Token
token.description:
To obtain your personal token, follow these steps:
1. Log in to your Airtable account.
2. Visit https://airtable.com/create/tokens/ to create one
3. Click on "+ Add a base" and select the base you want to use or all bases. To create new bases, also add the workspace under "+ Add a workspace".
4. Click on "+ Add a scope" and select "data.records:read", "data.records:write", "data.recordComments:read", "data.recordComments:write", "schema.bases:read" and "schema.bases:write" for full functionality.
5. Click on "Create token" and copy the token.

airtable_update_record.label: Update Record (Convert Values)
airtable_update_record.description: Changes the fields you give on a record, by field ID. An empty value leaves its field as it is.

recordId.label: Record
recordId.description: Starts with rec. The list shows the first 100 records.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Field values by field ID, such as {"fldXXXXXXXXXXXXXX": "Acme"}. An attachment field takes a file URL; select and linked-record fields take arrays.

airtable_clean_record.label: Clean Record
airtable_clean_record.description: Updates a record and empties every field you leave blank.

recordId.label: Record
recordId.description: Starts with rec. The list shows the first 100 records.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Field values by field ID, such as {"fldXXXXXXXXXXXXXX": "Acme"}. A field given as empty is cleared.

airtable_delete_record.label: Delete Record
airtable_delete_record.description: Deletes a record from a table.

recordId.label: Record
recordId.description: Starts with rec. The list shows the first 100 records.

airtable_add_comment_to_record.label: Add Comment to Record
airtable_add_comment_to_record.description: Adds a comment to an existing record.

recordId.label: Record
recordId.description: Starts with rec. The list shows the first 100 records.

parentCommentId.label: Parent Comment ID
parentCommentId.description: Reply in this comment's thread. Empty: a new top-level comment.

airtable_create_base.label: Create Base
airtable_create_base.description: Creates a base with the tables you give.

workspaceId.label: Workspace
workspaceId.description: The workspace ID, which starts with wsp. Copy it from the workspace's URL in Airtable.

tables.label: Tables
tables.description: Tables to create. The first field of each table is its primary field.

airtable_create_table.label: Create Table
airtable_create_table.description: Creates a table in a base.

description.label: Description
description.description: Shown under the table name in Airtable.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Fields for the table. The first one becomes the primary field.

airtable_find_base.label: Find Base
airtable_find_base.description: Finds the bases whose name contains a text.

baseName.label: Base Name
baseName.description: Bases whose name contains this text are returned.

airtable_find_table_by_id.label: Find Table by ID
airtable_find_table_by_id.description: Gets a table with its fields and views.

airtable_get_record_by_id.label: Get Record by ID
airtable_get_record_by_id.description: Gets one record by its ID.

recordId.label: Record
recordId.description: Starts with rec. The list shows the first 100 records.

airtable_find_table.label: Find Table
airtable_find_table.description: Finds a table of a base by its name.

tableName.label: Table Name
tableName.description: Exact table name. Case does not matter.

airtable_get_base_schema.label: Get Base Schema
airtable_get_base_schema.description: Lists every table in a base with its fields and views.

create_record_ai.label: Create Record
create_record_ai.description: Adds a record to a table.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table, or its exact name.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Field values by field name, such as {"Name": "Acme", "Status": "Active"}. Linked-record and multiple-select fields take arrays; attachment fields take [{"url": "https://..."}]. Airtable converts text to the field's type where it can.

update_record_ai.label: Update Record (Exact Values)
update_record_ai.description: Changes the fields you give on a record, by field name, as given.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table, or its exact name.

recordId.label: Record
recordId.description: Starts with rec. The list shows the first 100 records.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: New values by field name, such as {"Status": "Done"}. Other fields stay as they are, and null empties a field. Linked-record and multiple-select fields take arrays; attachment fields take [{"url": "https://..."}].

list_records.label: List Records
list_records.description: Lists the records of a table, or those a formula finds.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table, or its exact name.

filterByFormula.label: Filter By Formula
filterByFormula.description: Only records the formula is true for, such as {Status}="Done" or AND({Score}>5, FIND("ace", LOWER({Name}))). Field names go in {curly braces}.

view.label: View
view.description: A view ID or name. Only its records, in its order.

maxRecords.label: Max Records
maxRecords.description: The most records to give, from as many pages as that takes. Empty: the first page only, with the offset of the next.

pageSize.label: Page Size
pageSize.description: Records per page, from 1 to 100. Empty: 100.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: A JSON list such as [{"field": "Name", "direction": "asc"}]. The direction is asc or desc.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: A JSON list of the field names to give. Empty: every field.

list_bases.label: List Bases
list_bases.description: Lists every base the token can open.

upload_attachment_ai.label: Upload Attachment
upload_attachment_ai.description: Uploads base64 file content to an attachment field of a record.

recordId.label: Record
recordId.description: Starts with rec. Copy it from the record URL or an earlier step.

attachmentFieldId.label: Attachment Field
attachmentFieldId.description: The ID of an attachment field, which starts with fld. Get Base Schema lists the fields of type multipleAttachments.

file.label: File Content
file.description: The file content as base64, without a data: prefix.

contentType.label: Content Type
contentType.description: The MIME type of the file, such as image/png.

airtable_upload_file_to_column.label: Upload File to Column
airtable_upload_file_to_column.description: Uploads a file of the run to an attachment field of a record.

attachmentFieldId.label: Attachment Field
attachmentFieldId.description: The ID of an attachment field, which starts with fld. Get Base Schema lists the fields of type multipleAttachments.

recordId.label: Record
recordId.description: Starts with rec. The list shows the first 100 records.

file.label: File
file.description: A file from an earlier step.

contentType.label: Content Type
contentType.description: The MIME type of the file, such as image/png.

filename.label: File Name
filename.description: Name shown in Airtable. Empty: the uploaded file's own name.

airtable_upload_file_to_column.beforeRequest:
if (!('filename' in request.body)) request.body.filename = inputs.file;
return request;

upsert_records.label: Upsert Records
upsert_records.description: Creates or updates up to 10 records in one call.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table, or its exact name.

records.label: Records
records.description: A JSON list of up to 10 records, each such as {"fields": {"Name": "Acme", "Status": "Active"}}. Without fields to merge on, give the ID of each record to update: {"id": "recXXXX", "fields": {...}}.

fieldsToMergeOn.label: Fields To Merge On
fieldsToMergeOn.description: A JSON list of field names, such as ["Email"]. A record that matches on them is updated, the others are created. Empty: update each record by its ID.

typecast.label: Typecast
typecast.description: Airtable converts text to the field's type and adds missing select options. Off: values must have the field's type.

upsert_records.beforeRequest: const body = request.body; const records = body.records; if (!Array.isArray(records) || records.length === 0) throw new Error('Records must be a non-empty JSON array.'); if (records.length > 10) throw new Error('Airtable accepts at most 10 records per upsert call; received ' + records.length + '. Split into batches of 10.'); if (body.typecast === undefined) body.typecast = true; if (!(body.performUpsert.fieldsToMergeOn || []).length) delete body.performUpsert; return request;
upsert_records.afterResponse: return {records: response.records, count: response.records.length, createdRecords: response.createdRecords ?? [], updatedRecords: response.updatedRecords ?? []};

delete_records_batch.label: Delete Records Batch
delete_records_batch.description: Deletes up to 10 records by ID in one call.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table, or its exact name.

recordIds.label: Record IDs
recordIds.description: A JSON list of up to 10 record IDs, such as ["recAAA", "recBBB"].

delete_records_batch.beforeRequest: const ids = JSON.parse(inputs.recordIds); if (!Array.isArray(ids) || ids.length === 0) throw new Error('Record IDs must be a non-empty list.'); if (ids.length > 10) throw new Error('Airtable deletes at most 10 records per call; received ' + ids.length + '. Split into batches of 10.'); ids.forEach((id, index) => { request.query['records[' + index + ']'] = id; }); return request;

get_current_user.label: Get Current User
get_current_user.description: Gets the user of the token and its scopes.

search_records.label: Search Records
search_records.description: Finds the records whose field matches a value.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table, or its exact name.

searchField.label: Search Field
searchField.description: The exact name of the field to look in.

matchMode.label: Match Mode
matchMode.description: Contains finds the text anywhere in the field, with case. Exact finds a field that is the text, also a number or checkbox field by its text.

view.label: View
view.description: A view ID or name. Only its records.

update_table.label: Update Table
update_table.description: Renames a table or changes its description.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table, or its exact name.

update_table.beforeRequest: if (!inputs.name && !inputs.description) throw new Error('Supply at least one of New Name or New Description.'); return request;

create_field.label: Create Field
create_field.description: Adds a field (column) to a table.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table, or its exact name.

type.label: Field Type
type.description: An Airtable field type, such as singleLineText, number, singleSelect, multipleSelects, date, checkbox or multipleRecordLinks.

options.label: Options
options.description: Options of the type as JSON, such as {"choices": [{"name": "Todo"}, {"name": "Done"}]} for a select field or {"precision": 0} for a number. Text fields take none.

update_field.label: Update Field
update_field.description: Renames a field (column) or changes its description.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table itself: its name does not work here.

fieldId.label: Field ID
fieldId.description: Starts with fld. Get Base Schema lists the fields of each table.

update_field.beforeRequest: if (!inputs.name && !inputs.description) throw new Error('Supply at least one of New Name or New Description.'); return request;

list_record_comments.label: List Record Comments
list_record_comments.description: Lists the comments of a record.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table, or its exact name.

recordId.label: Record
recordId.description: Starts with rec. The list shows the first 100 records.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: The offset a previous call gave, for the next page.

list_record_comments.afterResponse: return {comments: response.comments, count: response.comments.length, offset: response.offset ?? null};

new_record.label: New Record
new_record.description: Triggers when a new record is added to the selected table.

view.label: View
view.description: Only records in this view are used. Empty: the whole table.
